Subject (in full) Assassination of Oak Sing Bim
Statement of Kim Kai San (金海山), Korean, who was deported to Korea on January 2, 1934.
Date February 7, 1934.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by D. J. Somerest.

In compliance with my request for information regarding the business connection between Kim Kai San, who was deported to Korea by the local Japanese Consular Police on January 2, 1934, and Oak Sing Bim, the deceased detective of the French Police, an officer attached to the local Intelligence Office of the Korean Government has furnished me with a copy of a report obtained from Korea on the understanding that this report is to be treated as strictly confidential.

M. Umemoto.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（左侧批注：See file x D. 1181）

page_data.en:
Statement of Kim Kei Sen (金海山), Korean, who was deported
to Korean on January 2, 1934.
--------------------------
During my stay at No. 310 Rue Bourgeat with Ih Kei Ling
(章東林), 42, from May to December, 1932, Oak Sing Bim
became acquainted with me. He knew that I dealt in drugs so he
often asked me to do business with him. Since my removal
to No. 153 Rue Marcel Tillot in January, 1933, Oak Sing Bim
visited me frequently. During the course of his visits in
November, 1933, he informed me that a certain foreign officer
of the French Police would like to invest money in some business,
so Oak and I met several times during the month to discuss the
establishment of a morphine factory. Oak, the foreigner and
I were to invest $1,000.00 each. In the beginning of December,
1933, I met the foreigner once in a house on Rue Tenant de la
Tour and on this occasion Oak spoke with the foreigner who
agreed to furnish a sum of $1,000.00. Later Oak told me that
his (Oak's) share of $1,000.00 will also be paid by this
foreigner. As I do not understand his language I did not speak
with the foreigner. I do not know his name except that he is
an employee of the French Police. On or about December 11, 1933,
Oak Sing Bim, Ko Shu Sen and I, after visiting several premises,
decided to rent a house at No. 7 Pih Loh Faung (畢樂坊), Route
Pichon, which was to have been occupied on December 16, but
owing to a delay in the installation of the electric lights
the removal did not take place. On the morning of December 18,
1933, I received a telephone call from Oak Sing Bim inquiring
about the furniture for the house. I asked him when he could
bring the money and in reply he said that he would call on the
foreigner. At about 6.30 p.m. on the same day, Oak came to my
house and handed me $1,100 saying that this sum was the foreigner's
investment in our business. Oak said that he would retain $50.00
as removal expenses. Oak also asked me to supply him with an
ounce of morphine. He then went downstairs to use the telephone,
but as he received no reply he left my house informing Ko Shu
page_data.zh:
金海山 (Kim Kei Sen)（朝鲜人，于1934年1月2日被驱逐至朝鲜）的陈述。
--------------------------
1932年5月至12月期间，我与42岁的章東林 (Ih Kei Ling) 同住于布尔热瓦路 (Rue Bourgeat) 310号，在此期间 Oak Sing Bim 与我相识。他知道我从事毒品交易，因此经常要求我与他做生意。自1933年1月我搬至马塞尔·蒂洛路 (Rue Marcel Tillot) 153号后，Oak Sing Bim 频繁来访。在1933年11月的拜访过程中，他告诉我，法租界巡捕房的一名外籍警官希望投资某项生意，因此 Oak 和我在该月内多次会面，讨论建立吗啡工厂的事宜。Oak、那名外籍人士和我将各出资1,000.00美元。1933年12月初，我在 Tenant de la Tour 路的一所房子里见过那名外籍人士一次，当时 Oak 与那名外籍人士交谈，对方同意提供1,000.00美元。后来 Oak 告诉我，他那1,000.00美元的份额也将由这名外籍人士支付。由于我不懂他的语言，我没有与那名外籍人士交谈。除了知道他是法租界巡捕房的雇员外，我不知道他的名字。1933年12月11日左右，Oak Sing Bim、Ko Shu Sen 和我在查看了几处房产后，决定租用毕勋路 (Route Pichon) 畢樂坊 (Pih Loh Faung) 7号的一所房子，原定于12月16日入住，但由于电灯安装延误，搬迁未能进行。1933年12月18日上午，我接到 Oak Sing Bim 的电话，询问房子的家具情况。我问他何时能带钱来，他回答说他会去拜访那名外籍人士。当天下午约6点30分，Oak 来到我家，递给我1,100美元，称这笔钱是那名外籍人士对我们生意的投资。Oak 说他留下50.00美元作为搬迁费用。Oak 还要求我供应他一盎司吗啡。随后他下楼使用电话，但因未得到回应，他离开我家时告诉 Ko Shu

page_data.en:
( 2 )
Sen that he would return next day for the morphine because
he would be busy that night. Soon after this, I heard
pistol shots. I did not know that Oak would visit me on
the night of December 18 because we had made no appointment.
I do not know who the murderer or murderers of Oak Sing Bim
may be.
At the French Police Station, I was informed by Oak's son
that a foreigner called on Oak Sing Bim at about 2.30 p.m.
December 18 and handed him a sum of money and that Oak left
his home at 5.30 p.m. in a hurry saying that he was busy.
On December 17, 1933, whilst I was returning from a visit
to one Wei Gee (偉池) at Chiu Mow Dien (九畝地), Nantao,
a number of Chinese loafers stopped me and searched my person
for opium. I think they did this upon instructions from one
Li Voong Noo (李鳳梧), who is a brother of Wei Gee and resides
in Pao Hung Li off Avenue Joffre. In November, 1933, Li
Voong Noo received a quantity of heroin from Ih Kei Ling for
sale but Li refused to pay. After this Li and Ih were on bad
terms. Li also became unfriendly with me because Ih Kei Ling
was in close touch with me. I do not know whether the two
visitors to my house prior to the visit of Oak Sing Bim on the
night of December 18 had any connection with Li Voong Noo.
I was told that some years ago Ih Kei Ling and An Kyo Kon
(安恭根), Korean, had defrauded a Cantonese of several
thousand dollars by proposing to him the establishment of a
gambling den in the vicinity of the Great World Amusement
Resort. Ih Kei Ling and An Kyo Kon had a dispute over the
division of the money but they continued their relations
until May, 1932, when An Kyo Kon disappeared after the Hongkew
Park Bomb Outrage in April, 1932. During my stay with Ih Kei
Ling, he used to inform me that he would establish a morphine
factory if An Kyo Kon would provide the funds but nothing was
done. An Kyo Kon used to keep in touch with prominent members
of the Korean Independence Party and it seems to me that he
was not in favour of Oak's joining the French Police.
page_data.zh:
( 2 )
Sen，他当晚很忙，第二天再来取吗啡。此后不久，我听到了枪声。我不知道 Oak 会在12月18日晚上来访，因为我们没有预约。我不知道谁是杀害 Oak Sing Bim 的凶手。
在法租界巡捕房，我从 Oak 的儿子那里得知，12月18日下午约2点30分，一名外籍人士拜访了 Oak Sing Bim 并交给他一笔钱，Oak 于下午5点30分匆忙离开家，称他很忙。
1933年12月17日，当我从南市九畝地 (Chiu Mow Dien) 拜访 Wei Gee (偉池) 回来时，一群中国无业游民拦住我，搜身查找鸦片。我认为他们是受居住在霞飞路宝亨里 (Pao Hung Li) 的 Wei Gee 的兄弟李鳳梧 (Li Voong Noo) 的指使这样做的。1933年11月，李鳳梧从章東林 (Ih Kei Ling) 处获得一批海洛因用于销售，但李拒绝付款。此后，李和章的关系恶化。李对我也变得不友好，因为章東林与我联系密切。我不知道在12月18日晚 Oak Sing Bim 来访之前到我家的两名访客是否与李鳳梧有关。
我听说几年前，章東林 (Ih Kei Ling) 和朝鲜人安恭根 (An Kyo Kon) 曾提议在大世界游乐场附近开设赌场，从而诈骗了一名广东人数千美元。章東林和安恭根在分钱问题上发生争执，但他们继续保持关系，直到1932年5月，安恭根在1932年4月虹口公园爆炸案后失踪。在我与章東林同住期间，他曾告诉我，如果安恭根提供资金，他将建立一家吗啡工厂，但未付诸实施。安恭根过去常与朝鲜独立党的知名成员保持联系，在我看来，他并不赞成 Oak 加入法租界巡捕房。

D. C. (Crime).

I have passed a copy of attached report by
D.S. Kim to Mr. Sarly, French Police, for what it
is worth.

Para. 3. Kim cannot give even an approximate
date of this visit to Nanchang. Chiang Kai-shek
has not been in Nanchang for the past four weeks
and such an invitation would be contrary to his
policy.

Para. 4. The Chinese Authorities are not likely
to admit this. It would be more correct to say
that these Korean radicals have moved to Nantao
to put extradition difficulties in the way of the
Japanese Consular people. The French Police know
nothing of a plot to assassinate the Consul-General
for France and Comdt Fabre, although the latter has
been the recipient of several threatening letters.

No mention is made by Kim that an officer of
the French Police (Marmorat) has had to resign as a
result of drug deals in which Oak and other Koreans were
also involved, a fact I am certain he is aware of but
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE FEB 7 1934）for obvious reasons prefers to ignore.

The statements made by two Koreans in custody
at the Japanese Consulate are very unsatisfactory as
detail, especially the origin and ownership of the various
sums of money mentioned, is very much lacking, and would
seem to indicate that the copies which the Japanese Consular
officials were good enough to give us were either abridged
editions or cooked.

That the motive for Oak's murder was political
is doubtful when it is reckoned that the French Political

副总监（刑事）。

我已将附上的 D.S. Kim 的报告副本转交给法租界巡捕房的 Sarly 先生，供其参考。

第3段。Kim 甚至无法给出这次访问南昌的大致日期。蒋介石在过去四周内不在南昌，且此类邀请违背他的政策。

第4段。中国当局不太可能承认这一点。更准确的说法是，这些朝鲜激进分子搬到了南市，以给日本领事馆人员制造引渡困难。法租界巡捕房对刺杀法国总领事和 Fabre 指挥官的阴谋一无所知，尽管后者曾收到多封恐吓信。

Kim 未提及法租界巡捕房的一名警官 (Marmorat) 因涉及毒品交易而被迫辞职，Oak 和其他朝鲜人也卷入其中，这一事实我确信他是知道的，但
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处副总监 1934年2月7日）出于显而易见的原因，他选择忽略。

在日本领事馆拘留的两名朝鲜人的陈述在细节上非常令人不满意，特别是所提到的各种款项的来源和所有权严重缺失，这似乎表明日本领事馆官员好意提供给我们的副本要么是删节版，要么是经过篡改的。

鉴于法租界政治

page_data.en:
-2-

Branch did not rely on him for Korean intelligence
of value and reference is made to drug trafficking
in the statements of the two Korean prisoners.
Summing up, there are good grounds for
suspicion that Kim's fear of assassination does
not arise out of loyalty or good service to the
Municipal Police.

（签名）
Superintendent.

（批：FILE
YR）
page_data.zh:
-2-

课并不依赖他提供有价值的朝鲜情报，且两名朝鲜囚犯的陈述中提到了毒品贩运，因此 Oak 被杀的动机是政治性的说法值得怀疑。
综上所述，有充分理由怀疑，Kim 对暗杀的恐惧并非源于对工部局警务处的忠诚或良好服务。

（签名）

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CRIMINAL REGISTRY.
No. D 5599
Special Branch Section,
Date 5 / 2 / 34
Date February 5, 1934

Subject (in full) Plot of Korean radicals to assassinate officials.

Made by D. S. Kim Forwarded by M. Nixon D.S.

Sir,
I have to report that recently, I have received
no information concerning the Korean radicals intention to
assassinate police officers. On January 18, I was warned
by the Japanese Consular Police not to enter the French
Concession as the Koreans had determined to take my life, but
I have not been able to gather further information on this
subject.
Acting upon instructions, I have made inquiries
into the activities of the Korean radicals and have learned
that the more dangerous elements, fearing apprehension by
the Japanese Consular Police have fled from the French
Concession to Nantao.
Recently General Chiang Kai Shek invited 4 Korean
leaders, including Kim Ku and An Kong Kun( reported t o be
responsible for the bombing outrage at Hongkew Park) to
proceed to Nanchang to discuss Korean affairs.
The Korean radicals who removed to Nantao have been
promised immunity from arrest by the Chinese authorities, and
it is reported that they are planning to assassinate the
French Consul and the Chief of the French Police, in order
to bring the question of the assistance rendered to the
Japanese authorities by the French Police to the French
Parliament.
The undersigned will endeavour to elicit further
information regarding the proposed plot in the near future.

DEPUTY COMMISSIONER :
FEB 7 1934
CRIME BRANCH
D. S. Kim
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch

日期 1934年2月5日

主题（全称）朝鲜激进分子刺杀官员的阴谋。

由 D. S. Kim 制作 由 M. Nixon D.S. 转呈。

先生，
我要报告的是，最近我没有收到关于朝鲜激进分子意图刺杀警察的情报。1月18日，日本领事馆警察警告我不要进入法租界，因为朝鲜人已决意取我性命，但我未能就此主题收集到更多情报。
根据指示，我对朝鲜激进分子的活动进行了调查，获悉那些更危险的分子因害怕被日本领事馆警察逮捕，已从法租界逃往南市。
最近，蒋介石将军邀请了包括金九 (Kim Ku) 和安恭根 (An Kong Kun)（据报对虹口公园爆炸案负责）在内的4名朝鲜领导人前往南昌讨论朝鲜事务。
迁往南市的朝鲜激进分子已得到中国当局不予逮捕的承诺，据报道，他们正计划刺杀法国领事和法租界巡捕房总监，以便将法租界巡捕房向日本当局提供协助的问题提交法国议会审议。
具名人将努力在近期获取有关该拟议阴谋的进一步情报。

1934年2月7日

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by D. J. Somesal.

In compliance with instructions, I have made inquiries

officers, but, up to the present, no developments have taken

Subject (in full)... Koreans plan to bomb S.M.C. Administration Building.

Made by... D. S. Umemoto. ... Forwarded by... O. O. Smeeton.

In connection with the attached translation from the
"Shanghai Mainichi", dated January 30, under the heading
"Koreans plan to bomb S.M.C. Administration Building", I called
upon Mr. Oki, a reporter of the "Mainichi", who stated that
the information was obtained from an English reporter and that
he (Oki) passed it to another reporter of the paper. The
"Mainichi", however, published the report without first having
it confirmed.

Enquiries at the various Japanese intelligence offices
show that they had no information regarding the plot to bomb
the S.M.C. Administration Building.

M. Umemoto.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
C.P.

DC (Crime)
（批：Information. I know
Oki & do not look upon
him as reliable.

由... D. S. Umemoto 制作。 ... 由... O. O. Smeeton 转呈。

就随附的1月30日《上海每日新闻》(Shanghai Mainichi) 标题为“朝鲜人计划轰炸工部局行政大楼”的译文而言，我拜访了《每日新闻》的记者 Oki 先生，他表示该信息是从一名英国记者那里获得的，而他 (Oki) 将其转交给了报社的另一名记者。然而，《每日新闻》在未先确认的情况下发布了该报道。

对各日本情报机构的查询显示，它们没有关于轰炸工部局行政大楼阴谋的情报。

M. Umemoto.

January 30, 1934. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

NIPPO

COMPLAINT AGAINST S.M.C. FIRE BRIGADE

At 1.30 p.m. yesterday fire broke out at No. 463 Dixwell Road occupied by a European. Fortunately there was no wind and the inmates of the house put out the fire immediately.
Although the fire could be easily seen from the Fire Station on Woosung Road, the Fire Brigade took 25 minutes to arrive at the scene.
Persons living in the neighbourhood are complaining that the Fire Brigade cannot be relied upon to act promptly.

MAINICHI

KOREANS PLAN TO BOMB S.M.C. ADMINISTRATION BUILDING

The plan of Koreans to bomb the Japanese Consulate on January 28 was frustrated by the measures adopted by the Japanese Consular Police with the assistance of the Shanghai Municipal Police.
It is reported that the Shanghai Municipal Police are taking special precautions because it is reported that the Koreans are planning to attack the Shanghai Municipal administration building because the Shanghai Municipal Council gave assistance to the Japanese Consulate to prevent Koreans from throwing bombs at the Consulate.
The Japanese Landing Force will continue to adopt precautionary measures for some time and night patrols will be on duty equipped with steel helmets and bullet-proof vests.

JAPANESE RESIDENTS RECOMMEND MR. FUNATSU AS CHAIRMAN OF THE COUNCIL

Mr. Funatsu, Director-General of the Japanese Cotton Mill Owners Association and Japanese member of the Shanghai Municipal Council, will arrive in Shanghai to-day.
It was reported that Mr. Funatsu intended to resign from the Shanghai Municipal Council owing to pressure of business necessitating his absence from Shanghai. However the Japanese ratepayers will recommend Mr. Funatsu and Mr. Okamoto this year.
A number of Japanese residents have started a movement to make Mr. Funatsu the chairman of the Shanghai Municipal Council.

《日日新闻》

投诉工部局消防队

昨日下午1时30分，狄思威路463号一欧籍人士寓所发生火灾。幸而当时无风，屋内人员立即将火扑灭。
虽然从吴淞路消防站可以清楚地看到火情，但消防队耗时25分钟才抵达现场。
附近居民抱怨称，消防队行动迟缓，不可信赖。

《每日新闻》

朝鲜人计划轰炸工部局行政大楼

朝鲜人于1月28日轰炸日本领事馆的计划，因日本领事警察在上海公共租界警务处的协助下采取措施而未能得逞。
据报，上海公共租界警务处正在采取特别预防措施，因为有消息称，朝鲜人正计划袭击上海公共租界工部局行政大楼，原因是上海公共租界工部局曾协助日本领事馆，阻止朝鲜人向领事馆投掷炸弹。
日本登陆部队将在一段时间内继续采取预防措施，夜间巡逻人员将佩戴钢盔和防弹背心执勤。

日侨推荐船津先生任工部局总董

日本棉纺同业公会理事长、上海公共租界工部局日籍董事船津先生将于今日抵沪。
此前有报道称，船津先生因业务繁忙需离开上海，拟辞去上海公共租界工部局董事职务。然而，今年日本纳税人将推荐船津先生和冈本先生。
部分日侨已发起运动，推举船津先生担任上海公共租界工部局总董。

Subject (in full) Gunpowder found on the hydrant on Woochang Rd, outside
Japanese Consulate.
Made by D.S.I. Hutton Forwarded by D.I. Telfer.

Sir,
At 9.30 a.m. 28/1/34 Japanese Consular Police Constable
Oheshi on Guard duty at the Corner of Woochang & Whampoo Rds
discovered a quantity of gunpowder on the top of a hydrant si-
tuated on the west side foot path on Woochang Rd about 4 ft from
Whampoo Rd corner. He reported the incident to the Inspector in
Charge of the Japanese Consular Police and also to J.P.C.66 who
was on duty outside the Japanese Consulate. The quantity of
powder found would half fill a .32 pistol shell case. The Japanese
Consulate removed the powder to the Consulate before the report
was made to the Station and it was ascertained that they burned
same. Only small particles of the powder could be found on the
top of the hydrant on the arrival of the D.O."C", C.I. Robertson
and party. The powder found is enclosed in attached envelope
and appears to have been extracted from cartridge case. No sus-
picious person was seen in the vicinity, and 4 Japanese Constables
were on duty round the Consulate augmented by 4 Japanese Consulate
Police. J.P.C.66 reported the occurrence when he went off duty
at 11 a.m.

I am,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名）W Hutton
D. S. I.

Date January 21, 1934.

Subject (in full) Radical Koreans plotting to murder Police Officers.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by A. J. Everest.

Information has been obtained to the effect that local
Korean terrorists, under the guidance of Kim Kyu, a prominent
member of the Korean Independence Party, are planning to throw
bombs at the Japanese Consulate and to murder those police officers
who have responsible for the arrest of Korean radicals as well as
the agents working for the police and pro-Japanese Koreans.
Among the names of persons who are to be dealt with in this
manner appears that of D. S. Kim of S 5, Special Branch.
It is believed that Kim Kyu is at present in Nanking.
Similar information has also been received by the local
Japanese Consular Police who have adopted special precautionary
measures within the building.

In connection with the murder of Oak Sung Bin, * E 1181.
Korean Detective of the French Police, the undersigned has
ascertained from an informer that the victim was murdered
by a Korean Assassination gang which was also responsible
for the assassination of Oak Kwan Bin on August 1, Suk Hyun * D 1169
Ku on August 17 and the attempted murder of Liu In Bal on
August 31. * D ...

The principal members of the gang are reported to be
An Kong Kun, brother of An Chung Kun who killed Prince Ito
at Harbin, Um Hang Sub, ex-interpreter of the French Police,
Kim Dong Wu, who at one time served in the Chinese army, one
Pak.

They have formed the gang under the leadership of
Kim Ku who is well known to the Chinese community as a leader
of Korean revolutionary terrorists responsible for the bomb
outrage at Hongkew Park in 1932. The gang also comprises
a number of Korean anarchists who committed robbery at the
home of a Korean Christian pastor named Cho Shang Sub in the
French Concession on July 15.

（左侧手写批注：Continue if any concrete information comes to hand）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER
JAN 4
(CRIME BRANCH)）

Formerly the members of the gang resided in Nantao
but now they are living some where in the vicinity of Rue de
Say Zeeng, French Concession, because since the murder of
Oak Sung Bin, they are afraid of being apprehended by the
Nantao Police.

They are now reported to be planning to continue
their assassination programme in which the undersigned is
reported to be included. The reason for their action is
reported to be that they do not want any Korean to serve
either in the French Police or the International Settlement

关于法国警察朝鲜籍侦探 Oak Sung Bin（音译），* E 1181 被杀一案，卑职从一名线人处获悉，受害者系被一个朝鲜暗杀团谋杀，该团伙还负责于8月1日刺杀 Oak Kwan Bin（音译），于8月17日刺杀 Suk Hyun Ku（音译）* D 1169，以及于8月31日企图谋杀 Liu In Bal（音译）。* D ...

据报，该团伙的主要成员包括：在哈尔滨刺杀伊藤亲王的安重根之弟安恭根（An Kong Kun，音译）、前法国警察翻译 Um Hang Sub（音译）、曾在中国军队服役的金东武（Kim Dong Wu，音译），以及一名 Pak（音译）。

据悉，该团伙是在金九的领导下成立的，金九在中国社区中广为人知，是朝鲜革命恐怖分子的领袖，对1932年虹口公园爆炸案负有责任。该团伙还包括数名朝鲜无政府主义者，他们曾于7月15日在法租界抢劫了一位名为 Cho Shang Sub（音译）的朝鲜基督教牧师的住所。

（左侧手写批注：如有具体信息到手，请继续）
（印章：副总巡官
1月4日
（罪案科））

该团伙成员以前居住在南市，但现在他们住在法租界赛珍路（Rue de Say Zeeng，音译）附近的某个地方，因为自从 Oak Sung Bin 被杀后，他们害怕被南市警察逮捕。

据报，他们现在正计划继续其暗杀行动，卑职据报也在目标之列。据报，他们采取行动的原因是不希望有任何朝鲜人在法国警察或国际租界
